name: balligh-server
description: Publishes Balligh clips to the Share Quran pages: renders a share link in headless Chrome, posts it.

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/auth.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:playwright-core --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
